newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot products ease with Calif. late - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot products ease with Calif. late - Oct 10.

text.p: U.S. Northwest spot product prices fell slightly on Thursday, reacting to general weakness in California values and stable supply from refineries.
"Everything's running well so (the market is) drifting down with," California, one Northwest trader said.
California regular unleaded gasoline eased two cents on the day to 61.50/62.50 cents a gallon while CARB grade gasolines held steady in late trade at 66.50/67.50 cents.
In Seattle, regular unleaded gasoline was assessed at 63/64 cents a gallon, down a cent from Wednesday.
Jet fuel in Seattle edged down to 75.50/76.50 cents a gallon, off two cents as the arrival of two cargoes undercut values in the Los Angeles market.
Low sulphur diesel lost a cent to 74/75 cents a gallon.
